page_title: BIL 0-1 ATM | Athletic Bilbao v Atletico Madrid 31/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Ruiz de Galarreta I. Calf Injury

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
90+2' 0 - 1 Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) is released by Alexander Sorloth, he surges into the box and smashes a great shot into the net after a one-on-one with the goalkeeper.
90+2' Ath Bilbao have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+1' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90+1' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) will replace Koke.
88' Ath Bilbao take a short corner kick.

87' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
86' Ath Bilbao are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
85' The foul by Koke (Atl. Madrid) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Alejandro Hernandez.
84' Diego Simeone has decided to substitute Antoine Griezmann and he is replaced by Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid).
81' We are about to witness a subsitution. Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) for Oihan Sancet.
80' Half-chance! Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) plays a pass into the box, but Juan Musso reacts well to snuff out the attack.
79' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
77' Juan Musso (Atl. Madrid) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
76' Atl. Madrid are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
75' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Conor Gallagher trots off the pitch and is replaced by Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid).
71' Today's match ends for Inaki Williams who will be replaced by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao).
71' The referee allows time for a substitution. Julian Alvarez will be replaced by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid).
70' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Samuel Lino will be replaced by Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid).
68' A long pass finds Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies towards the left side of the goal, but Juan Musso reacts well to make a good save.
64' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Benat Prados Diaz as he is replaced by Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao).
64' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to make a change. Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) replaces Gorka Guruzeta.
64' A substitution has been made. Ander Herrera goes off and Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
62' Atl. Madrid work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

62' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Atl. Madrid.

60' Ooh that was close! Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
59' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
57' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
56' Ath Bilbao keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
54' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
54' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
52' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
51' Corner kicks – 0:1.
50' Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) makes a strong challenge and Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul.
47' The goal by Ath Bilbao won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
47' Attention! Referee Alejandro Hernandez straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
46' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The end of the first half.

45' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Atl. Madrid are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
43' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Alejandro Hernandez saw the whole situation.
43' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

40' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
38' The possession of the ball – 60:40.
35' The yellow card is received by Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao).
34' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
32' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) makes a rough challenge and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul. Ath Bilbao are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
30' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
29' The ball is cleared after Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

28' Atl. Madrid slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
27' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
25' Ath Bilbao are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
24' Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
21' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
18' Ath Bilbao seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
15' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) sees a yellow card from Alejandro Hernandez after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
14' The resulting set piece from Atl. Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.

13' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. Atl. Madrid win a corner.
10' Ath Bilbao restart play with a quick free kick.
10' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
6' Atl. Madrid keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
4' Wonderful movement by Atl. Madrid. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

2' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the penalty box and unleashes a volley towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Ath Bilbao will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Hernandez will supervise the game today.
